content.title: Freelance economy is actually flourishing with AI: Upwork CEO
content.description:
While workers around the world are growing increasingly concerned about AI and the potential threat it poses to certain professions, AI has been a labor driver that has fueled more online job postings, according to freelancer job site Upwork (UPWK).

Upwork CEO Hayden Brown sits down with Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi to talk more about the growth in the contingent labor market that artificial intelligence has contributed to.

Also watch the Wall Street Journal's Greg Ip explain to Yahoo Finance why people are still uncomfortable with AI.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
